sentences.text:
The applicant is seeking for quashing of First Information Report bearing Crime No.619 of 2022
registered for the offence punishable under Sections 376(1), 506 read with Section 34 of the Indian
Penal Code and he also prays to quash the related charge-sheet which is registered as R.C.C. No.246
of 2022.
3.  While seeking interim relief, it has been pointed out that similar allegations were leveled against co- accused Vinod Deshpande by the informant.
This Court in Criminal Application (APL) no.934 of 2022 has quashed the First Information Report against him.

4. In the light of that we have seen the allegation made by the prosecutrix against the applicant and co- accused, which are similar in nature.
5. Issue notice to the respondents, returnable on 2 12 apl 64.2023 10.02.2023.
